title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
title_zh: 答案正确，大门紧闭：面向验证屏障下 GUI 智能体的 SolveBind

paragraphs.en: Real-world websites and applications often deploy CAPTCHAs and other anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals, such as interaction trajectories and timing, rather than outcomes alone, to distinguish human operators from automated agents. We refer to such settings as protected GUI environments , where correctly solving a local verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion. An agent must also convert solver outputs into interactions accepted by the environment and adapt its execution based on runtime feedback under time constraints. For these environments, we introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework that combines hierarchical solving with runtime supervision . A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive , Ground , Solve , Act , and Verify capabilities. A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence to allow them to be revised as new evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets. For verification, across nine CAPTCHA task families and nine backbone models, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight backbones, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.3–34.5 percentage points. For end-to-end task completion, it achieves the highest success rate on all six backbones evaluated on AndroidWorld. In a paired GPT-5.5 analysis, MobileAgent produces correct answers but fails dynamic verification on 13 of 90 tasks; SolveBind succeeds on seven of these tasks. With automatic submission retained, removing binding reduces success from 82.22% to 71.56% and increases latency and token usage. Recovery caps reduce execution cost with a small observed success trade-off: removing them raises success from 82.22% to 83.56%, while increasing latency and token usage to 3.7 × \times and 2.4 × \times their full-supervision values, respectively. These results support evidence-grounded execution control while identifying a success–cost trade-off in recovery and failure boundaries of heuristic submission rules.
paragraphs.zh: 现实中的网站和应用通常部署 CAPTCHA（验证码）及其他反自动化机制，这些机制利用交互轨迹与时间节奏等行为信号，而不仅仅依据结果，来区分人类操作者与自动化智能体。 我们将此类环境称为受保护 GUI 环境，在这些环境中，仅正确解决一个局部验证任务并不足以完成端到端任务。 智能体还必须将求解器的输出转换为环境可接受的交互，并在时间限制下根据运行时反馈调整其执行。 针对这类环境，我们提出 SolveBind，一个将分层求解与运行时监督相结合的 GUI 智能体框架。 分层求解树将验证任务分解为相互依赖的感知、定位、求解、执行与验证五种能力。 运行时监督器以工具获取的证据为依据落实动作承诺，使其能够随着新证据的到来而修订，并在明确的恢复预算下调解执行。 在验证方面，跨越九个 CAPTCHA 任务族和九个骨干模型，SolveBind 在八个骨干模型上取得最高成功率，超过最强基线 13.3 至 34.5 个百分点。 在端到端任务完成方面，它在 AndroidWorld 上评估的全部六个骨干模型上均取得最高成功率。 在 GPT-5.5 的配对分析中，MobileAgent 能给出正确答案，但在 90 个任务中的 13 个上未能通过动态验证；SolveBind 则在其中 7 个任务上取得成功。 在保留自动提交的情况下，移除绑定会使成功率从 82.22% 降至 71.56%，并增加延迟与 token 用量。 恢复上限以观察到的较小成功率损失为代价降低执行成本：移除恢复上限会使成功率从 82.22% 升至 83.56%，但延迟和 token 用量分别增至完全监督水平的 3.7 倍和 2.4 倍。 这些结果支持以证据为依据的执行控制，同时揭示了恢复机制中成功与成本之间的权衡，以及启发式提交规则的失败边界。

paragraphs.en: GUI agents aim to translate users’ task intents into complete interaction workflows, transforming requests such as retrieving information, filling out forms, or managing files into action sequences that span multiple pages and applications ( He et al., 2024 ; Agashe et al., 2025a ; Rawles et al., 2025 ) . Real-world services, however, often deploy anti-automation mechanisms that rely on behavioral signals, such as interaction trajectories and timing, rather than outcomes alone, to distinguish human operators from automated agents ( Acien et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Even if an agent has identified a viable solution, it must still advance the task through interactions accepted by the environment within the available time budget, so verification checkpoints become an integral part of task execution rather than an external obstacle to it.
paragraphs.zh: GUI 智能体旨在将用户的任务意图转化为完整的交互工作流，把诸如检索信息、填写表单或管理文件等请求转换为跨越多个页面和应用程序的动作序列（He et al., 2024；Agashe et al., 2025a；Rawles et al., 2025）。 然而，现实世界中的服务通常会部署依赖行为信号（如交互轨迹和时序）而非仅依据结果来区分人类操作者与自动化智能体的反自动化机制（Acien et al., 2022；Wang et al., 2026）。 即使智能体已经找到了可行的解决方案，它仍必须在可用的时间预算内通过环境所接受的交互来推进任务，因此验证检查点成为任务执行中不可分割的一部分，而非其外部障碍。

paragraphs.en: Consider the invoice-download task in Figure 1 . The agent locates the booking, requests the invoice, and reaches a human-verification gate before saving the file. Although it correctly identifies the target, the attempt can still be rejected because the verification mechanism also evaluates behavioral signals such as the drag trajectory and timing ( Acien et al., 2022 ; Song et al., 2026 ) . The bottleneck therefore lies not only in solving the local challenge, but also in executing the solution in a manner accepted by the environment. Re-solving may not resolve the rejection, while repeated attempts consume the limited verification budget and delay task completion. This illustrates why protected GUI environments require agents to coordinate local solving with feedback-aware execution.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑图 1 中的发票下载任务。 智能体定位到预订记录，请求发票，并在保存文件之前遇到一个人机验证关卡。 尽管它正确识别了目标，但尝试仍可能被拒绝，因为验证机制还会评估拖拽轨迹和时机等行为信号（Acien et al., 2022; Song et al., 2026）。 因此，瓶颈不仅在于解决局部挑战，还在于以环境可接受的方式执行解决方案。 重新求解未必能化解拒绝，而反复尝试会消耗有限的验证预算并延误任务完成。 这说明了为什么受保护的图形界面环境要求智能体将局部求解与具备反馈感知的执行相协调。

paragraphs.en: Interactive verification and behavioral discrimination make this a broader execution problem rather than an issue confined to a single CAPTCHA type. HLL ( Song et al., 2026 ) jointly evaluates task responses and interaction evidence in dynamic CAPTCHA tasks, revealing a gap between correctly solving a challenge and passing verification. Turing Test on Screen ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) further shows that touch behavior alone can distinguish agents from humans. We refer to GUI environments equipped with anti-automation mechanisms that monitor interaction behavior and distinguish automated from human operation as protected GUI environments . Such evidence may derive from a single action, a local interaction sequence, or a longer execution history, shaping the conditions under which subsequent execution proceeds ( Acien et al., 2022 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . We focus on two outcomes in these environments: task success rate and end-to-end latency.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式验证与行为判别使其成为一个更广泛的执行问题，而非局限于单一 CAPTCHA 类型的问题。 HLL（Song 等，2026）在动态 CAPTCHA 任务中联合评估任务响应与交互证据，揭示了正确解决挑战与通过验证之间的差距。 屏幕上的图灵测试（Zhu 等，2026）进一步表明，仅凭触控行为即可将智能体与人类区分开来。 我们将配备了监控交互行为并区分自动化操作与人类操作的反自动化机制的 GUI 环境称为受保护 GUI 环境。 此类证据可能来自单个动作、局部交互序列或更长的执行历史，并由此塑造后续执行得以进行的条件（Acien 等，2022；Song 等，2026；Wang 等，2026）。 我们关注这些环境中的两个结果：任务成功率和端到端延迟。

sents.en: We focus on two outcomes in these environments: task success rate and end-to-end latency.
sents.zh: 我们关注这些环境中的两个结果：任务成功率和端到端延迟。

paragraphs.en: Existing GUI-agent frameworks combine hierarchical planning with specialized tools to improve long-horizon decision making and interface grounding ( Agashe et al., 2025a ; Agashe et al., 2025b ) . In protected settings, however, these capabilities must be coordinated with the agent’s current execution state. Redundant actions and costly planning or reflection calls increase end-to-end latency ( Abhyankar et al., 2026 ) , while undetected action failures can lead to ineffective repetition and error accumulation ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . The central challenge is therefore determining which solver outputs should constrain execution and which observations should cause the agent to revise its next action . Our key idea is to treat solver outputs as runtime evidence that can be retained and revised. When the evidence supports a concrete action, the runtime records it as an action commitment and prioritizes that action until new observations update that evidence or trigger reconsideration. This coordination is motivated by rational metareasoning: computation should be weighed against both its cost and its expected value for the next decision ( Russell and Wefald, 1991 ; Hay et al., 2012 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的GUI智能体框架将分层规划与专用工具相结合，以提升长程决策与界面定位能力（Agashe et al., 2025a; Agashe et al., 2025b）。 然而，在受保护的环境中，这些能力必须与智能体的当前执行状态相协调。 冗余动作以及代价高昂的规划或反思调用会增加端到端延迟（Abhyankar et al., 2026），而未被检测到的动作失败则会导致无效重复和错误累积（Zhang et al., 2026）。 因此，核心挑战在于确定哪些求解器输出应当约束执行，以及哪些观察结果应当促使智能体修改其下一个动作。 我们的核心思想是将求解器输出视为可以保留和修改的运行时证据。 当该证据支持某个具体动作时，运行时会将其记录为动作承诺，并优先执行该动作，直到新的观察结果更新该证据或触发重新考量。 这种协调机制源自理性元推理的思想：计算应当同时权衡其成本及其对下一个决策的预期价值（Russell and Wefald, 1991; Hay et al., 2012）。

paragraphs.en: Building on this idea, we introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical tool-based solving with runtime supervision. A hierarchical solving tree organizes capability dependencies and alternative tool branches, allowing the model to select the capabilities needed for the current execution state. The runtime supervisor binds tool-derived evidence to action commitments and, under full supervision, prioritizes admissible pending commitments over conflicting action proposals. Execution feedback then updates a shared protocol state that governs workflow progression, verification, and bounded recovery, enabling subsequent attempts to preserve still-valid evidence and revise affected assumptions invalidated by new observations. Task adapters connect this protocol to different environments through task-specific primitives, tools, and completion interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一思路，我们提出 SolveBind，一个将分层基于工具的求解与运行时监督相结合的图形界面智能体（GUI-agent）框架。 分层求解树组织能力依赖关系与备选工具分支，使模型能够选择当前执行状态所需的能力。 运行时监督器将工具产生的证据绑定到动作承诺上，并在完全监督下优先采纳可准许的待定承诺，而非相互冲突的动作提议。 随后，执行反馈更新一个共享的协议状态，该状态管理工作流推进、验证与有界恢复，使后续尝试能够保留仍然有效的证据，并修订被新观察结果所推翻的受影响假设。 任务适配器通过任务特定的原语、工具与完成接口，将该协议连接到不同的环境。

sents.en: Building on this idea, we introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical tool-based solving with runtime supervision.

sents.en: A hierarchical solving tree organizes capability dependencies and alternative tool branches, allowing the model to select the capabilities needed for the current execution state.
sents.zh: 分层求解树组织能力依赖关系与备选工具分支，使模型能够选择当前执行状态所需的能力。

sents.en: The runtime supervisor binds tool-derived evidence to action commitments and, under full supervision, prioritizes admissible pending commitments over conflicting action proposals.
sents.zh: 运行时监督器将工具产生的证据绑定到动作承诺上，并在完全监督下优先采纳可准许的待定承诺，而非相互冲突的动作提议。

sents.en: Execution feedback then updates a shared protocol state that governs workflow progression, verification, and bounded recovery, enabling subsequent attempts to preserve still-valid evidence and revise affected assumptions invalidated by new observations.
sents.zh: 随后，执行反馈更新一个共享的协议状态，该状态管理工作流推进、验证与有界恢复，使后续尝试能够保留仍然有效的证据，并修订被新观察结果所推翻的受影响假设。

sents.en: Task adapters connect this protocol to different environments through task-specific primitives, tools, and completion interfaces.
sents.zh: 任务适配器通过任务特定的原语、工具与完成接口，将该协议连接到不同的环境。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SolveBind on nine HLL dynamic verification families ( Song et al., 2026 ) and AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) , across nine foundation models and three baseline harnesses. On verification tasks, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight of nine backbones, exceeding the strongest baseline by 13.3–34.5 percentage points. On general GUI tasks, it leads on all six evaluated backbones while reducing end-to-end latency in most comparisons. A paired analysis finds 13 correct-answer dynamic rejections under MobileAgent across 90 GPT-5.5 tasks, seven of which SolveBind resolves. With automatic submission fixed, relaxing binding reduces success from 185/225 to 161/225, isolating the effect of dispatch precedence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在九个 HLL 动态验证族（Song 等，2026）和 AndroidWorld（Rawles 等，2025）上，跨九个基础模型和三个基线框架对 SolveBind 进行评估。 在验证任务上，SolveBind 在九个骨干模型中的八个上取得最高成功率，超出最强基线 13.3–34.5 个百分点。 在通用 GUI 任务上，它在全部六个受测骨干模型上均领先，同时在大多数对比中降低了端到端延迟。 配对分析发现，在 90 个 GPT-5.5 任务中，MobileAgent 出现 13 次正确答案的动态拒绝，其中七个被 SolveBind 解决。 在固定自动提交的情况下，放宽绑定使成功率从 185/225 降至 161/225，从而分离出调度优先级的影响。

paragraphs.en: We formulate GUI task execution in protected GUI environments , distinguishing goal achievement from environmental acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在受保护的 GUI 环境中构建 GUI 任务执行的公式化表述，区分目标达成与环境接受。

paragraphs.en: We formulate three design principles from rational metareasoning: evidence-grounded commitment, progress-checked transition, and feedback-directed bounded recovery. We instantiate these three principles in SolveBind, which pairs a hierarchical solving tree with a runtime supervisor that binds tool evidence to revisable action commitments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从理性元推理中归纳出三条设计原则：基于证据的承诺、经进度校验的转换，以及由反馈引导的有界恢复。 我们在 SolveBind 中实例化了这三条原则，该方法将一个分层求解树与一个运行时监督器相结合，该监督器将工具证据绑定到可修订的动作承诺上。

sents.en: We formulate three design principles from rational metareasoning: evidence-grounded commitment, progress-checked transition, and feedback-directed bounded recovery.
sents.zh: 我们从理性元推理中归纳出三条设计原则：基于证据的承诺、经进度校验的转换，以及由反馈引导的有界恢复。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SolveBind across nine backbones, three baseline harnesses, and two environments, showing success and latency improvements in multiple configurations and using ablations to assess the effects of runtime-control configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在九个骨干模型、三个基线测试框架和两种环境中评估 SolveBind，展示了在多种配置下成功率和延迟的改进，并通过消融实验评估运行时控制配置的影响。

paragraphs.en: GUI agent harnesses and native policies. GUI-agent research follows two complementary directions. External harnesses organize multimodal models through planning, tool use, and memory: WebVoyager ( He et al., 2024 ) supports web interaction; MobileAgent ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and AppAgent ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) coordinate mobile perception and action; Agent S ( Agashe et al., 2025a ) uses experience-augmented hierarchical planning; and Agent S2 ( Agashe et al., 2025b ) combines a generalist planner with specialist grounding. Native policies, by contrast, directly learn interface grounding ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Gou et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2024 ) or integrate perception, reasoning, and action generation ( Qin et al., 2025 ) . Evaluation spans action prediction from recorded interaction traces ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Rawles et al., 2023 ) and task completion in executable environments ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2025 ) . These settings primarily assess grounding accuracy and goal achievement, rather than whether execution is accepted based on interaction behavior. SolveBind builds on the external-harness paradigm but explicitly coordinates task solving with environmental acceptance: an action may target the correct interface element yet still be rejected, requiring execution to account for both the intended effect and the conditions under which the environment permits progress.
paragraphs.zh: GUI 智能体框架与原生策略。 GUI 智能体研究沿两个互补方向发展。 外部框架通过规划、工具使用和记忆来组织多模态模型：WebVoyager（He et al., 2024）支持网页交互；MobileAgent（Wang et al., 2024）和 AppAgent（Zhang et al., 2025）协调移动端的感知与动作；Agent S（Agashe et al., 2025a）采用经验增强的分层规划；Agent S2（Agashe et al., 2025b）则将通用规划器与专用定位相结合。 相比之下，原生策略直接学习界面定位（Cheng et al., 2024；Gou et al., 2025；Hong et al., 2024），或将感知、推理与动作生成集成在一起（Qin et al., 2025）。 评估涵盖基于记录交互轨迹的动作预测（Deng et al., 2023；Rawles et al., 2023），以及在可执行环境中完成任务（Zhou et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2024；Rawles et al., 2025）。 这些设置主要评估定位准确性与目标达成情况，而非执行是否基于交互行为被接受。 SolveBuild 建立在外部框架范式之上，但显式地将任务求解与环境接受相协调：一个动作即使指向了正确的界面元素，仍可能被拒绝，这要求执行过程同时考虑预期效果以及环境允许推进的条件。

paragraphs.en: Execution verification and recovery. Existing frameworks differ in where verification intervenes, what execution decisions it constrains, and how recovery is bounded. VeriSafe ( Lee et al., 2025 ) translates user instructions into logical specifications and checks proposed actions before execution, advising on predicate mismatches while blocking critical violations. VLAA-GUI ( Han et al., 2026 ) verifies action effects and completion claims, using repetition detection and strategy-switching directives to constrain subsequent decisions while leaving replacement actions to its manager. StructAgent ( Wu et al., 2026 ) combines low-level effect checks with verifier-backed milestone updates and can return execution to the planner. MAPLE ( Guo et al., 2025 ) compares observed states with predicted postconditions and constructs recovery plans, returning to high-level replanning after two recovery failures. MobileUse ( Li et al., 2025 ) uses hierarchical, on-demand reflection to support recovery while limiting overhead. VeriGUI ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) learns effect prediction and self-correction within the policy, rather than relying on an independent dispatch controller. In SolveBind, every action dispatch passes through the supervisor. Under full control, admissible pending commitments take precedence over conflicting action proposals. Execution feedback updates their supporting evidence, preserving valid commitments while triggering reconsideration when that support no longer holds. Recovery is budgeted by category, with attempts and refreshes tracked separately. Our focus is therefore not verification alone, but the coordination of evidence-supported dispatch with rejection-aware, bounded recovery. More broadly, ReAct and Reflexion incorporate environmental or evaluative feedback into reasoning ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) , whereas intrinsic self-correction may fail without reliable external feedback ( Huang et al., 2024 ) . Our baseline cases, detailed in Appendix D.8 , reveal a complementary failure mode: an agent may correctly diagnose a failure yet still repeat the rejected action.
paragraphs.zh: 执行验证与恢复。 现有框架在验证介入的位置、约束的执行决策以及恢复的边界限制方面各不相同。 VeriSafe（Lee et al., 2025）将用户指令转化为逻辑规范，并在执行前检查拟议动作，对谓词不匹配提供建议，同时阻止严重违规。 VLAA-GUI（Han et al., 2026）验证动作效果与完成声明，利用重复检测和策略切换指令来约束后续决策，同时将替换动作留给其管理器处理。 StructAgent（Wu et al., 2026）将底层效果检查与基于验证器的里程碑更新相结合，并可将执行交还给规划器。 MAPLE（Guo et al., 2025）将观测到的状态与预测的后置条件进行比较并构建恢复计划，在两次恢复失败后返回高层重新规划。 MobileUse（Li et al., 2025）使用分层、按需的反思来支持恢复，同时限制开销。 VeriGUI（Zhang et al., 2026）在策略内部学习效果预测与自我纠错，而非依赖独立的调度控制器。 在 SolveBind 中，每个动作调度都要经过监督者。 在完全控制下，可采纳的待定承诺优先于相冲突的动作提案。 执行反馈会更新这些承诺的支持证据，在证据仍然成立时保留有效承诺，而在支持不再成立时触发重新考量。 恢复按类别进行预算，尝试次数与刷新次数分别追踪。 因此，我们的重点不仅仅是验证本身，而是将基于证据的调度与具备拒绝感知的、有界恢复相协调。 更广泛地说，ReAct 和 Reflexion 将环境或评估性反馈融入推理（Yao et al., 2022；Shinn et al., 2023），而内在的自我纠错在缺乏可靠外部反馈时可能失效（Huang et al., 2024）。 我们在附录 D.8 中详述的基线案例揭示了一种互补的失败模式：智能体可能正确诊断出失败，却仍然重复被拒绝的动作。

paragraphs.en: Protected interaction and execution efficiency. CAPTCHA research has documented vulnerabilities in semantic image challenges ( Sivakorn et al., 2016 ) and the human burden of deployed verification ( Searles et al., 2023 ) . Recent solvers exploit language and vision-language models: Halligan formulates visual CAPTCHA solving as search ( Teoh et al., 2025 ) , while Oedipus decomposes reasoning CAPTCHAs into DSL-guided substeps ( Deng et al., 2025 ) . Salman and Bicakci ( Salman and Bicakci, 2026 ) study adaptation across CAPTCHA encounters by using VLM outputs to update a detector; our focus is evidence reuse and revision within task execution. Open CaptchaWorld evaluates multimodal agents on diverse interactive CAPTCHA puzzles ( Luo et al., 2025 ) . Next-Gen CAPTCHAs develops scalable interactive challenges around persistent human–agent capability gaps ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Beyond puzzle solving, behavioral detection considers how interactions are performed: BeCAPTCHA-Mouse ( Acien et al., 2022 ) distinguishes human and synthetic input using trajectory-level neuromotor features, while FP-Agent ( Wang et al., 2026 ) finds behavioral fingerprints more discriminative than shared browser fingerprints. HLL ( Song et al., 2026 ) evaluates answers and interaction evidence, while Turing Test on Screen ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) measures the distinguishability of agent-generated touch behavior. Together, these studies motivate separating local challenge solving from environmental acceptance. ReCAP ( Chen et al., 2026 ) addresses CAPTCHA solving through trajectory generation and self-corrective fine-tuning of native GUI policies. Its interactive benchmark evaluates puzzle solving but does not simulate behavioral biometrics such as cursor speed or acceleration. In contrast, SolveBind leaves the backbone unchanged and coordinates execution at runtime under interaction-dependent validation. The distinction concerns the acceptance criterion and execution-control mechanism, rather than whether the task itself is interactive. Finally, redundant actions and expensive planning or reflection increase end-to-end latency ( Abhyankar et al., 2026 ) , motivating joint evaluation of task success and completion time rather than treating rapid failure as efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 受保护的交互与执行效率。 CAPTCHA 研究已经记录了语义图像挑战中的漏洞（Sivakorn 等，2016）以及已部署验证给人类带来的负担（Searles 等，2023）。 近期的求解器利用语言模型和视觉-语言模型：Halligan 将视觉 CAPTCHA 求解形式化为搜索问题（Teoh 等，2025），而 Oedipus 将推理型 CAPTCHA 分解为 DSL 引导的子步骤（Deng 等，2025）。 Salman 和 Bicakci（Salman 和 Bicakci，2026）通过利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）的输出来更新检测器，研究跨 CAPTCHA 遭遇的适应性；我们的重点则是任务执行过程中的证据复用与修订。 Open CaptchaWorld 在多样化的交互式 CAPTCHA 谜题上评估多模态智能体（Luo 等，2025）。 Next-Gen CAPTCHAs 围绕持续存在的人机能力差距开发可扩展的交互式挑战（Liu 等，2026）。 在谜题求解之外，行为检测还考虑交互是如何被执行的：BeCAPTCHA-Mouse（Acien 等，2022）利用轨迹层面的神经运动特征区分人类输入与合成输入，而 FP-Agent（Wang 等，2026）发现行为指纹比共享的浏览器指纹更具区分性。 HLL（Song 等，2026）对答案和交互证据进行评估，而 Turing Test on Screen（Zhu 等，2026）衡量智能体生成的触摸行为的可区分性。 这些研究共同促使我们将局部挑战求解与环境接受判定分离开来。 ReCAP（Chen 等，2026）通过轨迹生成和原生 GUI 策略的自我纠正微调来解决 CAPTCHA 求解问题。 其交互式基准评估谜题求解，但并不模拟诸如光标速度或加速度之类的行为生物特征。 相比之下，SolveBind 保持主干模型不变，并在依赖交互的验证下于运行时协调执行。 这一区别涉及接受判定标准与执行控制机制，而非任务本身是否具有交互性。 最后，冗余动作以及昂贵的规划或反思会增加端到端延迟（Abhyankar 等，2026），这促使我们联合评估任务成功与完成时间，而不是将快速失败视为高效。

sents.en: Protected interaction and execution efficiency.
sents.zh: 受保护的交互与执行效率。

sents.en: CAPTCHA research has documented vulnerabilities in semantic image challenges ( Sivakorn et al., 2016 ) and the human burden of deployed verification ( Searles et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: CAPTCHA 研究已经记录了语义图像挑战中的漏洞（Sivakorn 等，2016）以及已部署验证给人类带来的负担（Searles 等，2023）。

sents.en: Recent solvers exploit language and vision-language models: Halligan formulates visual CAPTCHA solving as search ( Teoh et al., 2025 ) , while Oedipus decomposes reasoning CAPTCHAs into DSL-guided substeps ( Deng et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 近期的求解器利用语言模型和视觉-语言模型：Halligan 将视觉 CAPTCHA 求解形式化为搜索问题（Teoh 等，2025），而 Oedipus 将推理型 CAPTCHA 分解为 DSL 引导的子步骤（Deng 等，2025）。

sents.en: Salman and Bicakci ( Salman and Bicakci, 2026 ) study adaptation across CAPTCHA encounters by using VLM outputs to update a detector; our focus is evidence reuse and revision within task execution.
sents.zh: Salman 和 Bicakci（Salman 和 Bicakci，2026）通过利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）的输出来更新检测器，研究跨 CAPTCHA 遭遇的适应性；我们的重点则是任务执行过程中的证据复用与修订。

sents.en: Open CaptchaWorld evaluates multimodal agents on diverse interactive CAPTCHA puzzles ( Luo et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: Open CaptchaWorld 在多样化的交互式 CAPTCHA 谜题上评估多模态智能体（Luo 等，2025）。

sents.en: Next-Gen CAPTCHAs develops scalable interactive challenges around persistent human–agent capability gaps ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Next-Gen CAPTCHAs 围绕持续存在的人机能力差距开发可扩展的交互式挑战（Liu 等，2026）。

sents.en: Beyond puzzle solving, behavioral detection considers how interactions are performed: BeCAPTCHA-Mouse ( Acien et al., 2022 ) distinguishes human and synthetic input using trajectory-level neuromotor features, while FP-Agent ( Wang et al., 2026 ) finds behavioral fingerprints more discriminative than shared browser fingerprints.
sents.zh: 在谜题求解之外，行为检测还考虑交互是如何被执行的：BeCAPTCHA-Mouse（Acien 等，2022）利用轨迹层面的神经运动特征区分人类输入与合成输入，而 FP-Agent（Wang 等，2026）发现行为指纹比共享的浏览器指纹更具区分性。

sents.en: HLL ( Song et al., 2026 ) evaluates answers and interaction evidence, while Turing Test on Screen ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) measures the distinguishability of agent-generated touch behavior.
sents.zh: HLL（Song 等，2026）对答案和交互证据进行评估，而 Turing Test on Screen（Zhu 等，2026）衡量智能体生成的触摸行为的可区分性。

sents.en: Together, these studies motivate separating local challenge solving from environmental acceptance.
sents.zh: 这些研究共同促使我们将局部挑战求解与环境接受判定分离开来。

sents.en: ReCAP ( Chen et al., 2026 ) addresses CAPTCHA solving through trajectory generation and self-corrective fine-tuning of native GUI policies.
sents.zh: ReCAP（Chen 等，2026）通过轨迹生成和原生 GUI 策略的自我纠正微调来解决 CAPTCHA 求解问题。

sents.en: Its interactive benchmark evaluates puzzle solving but does not simulate behavioral biometrics such as cursor speed or acceleration.
sents.zh: 其交互式基准评估谜题求解，但并不模拟诸如光标速度或加速度之类的行为生物特征。

sents.en: In contrast, SolveBind leaves the backbone unchanged and coordinates execution at runtime under interaction-dependent validation.
sents.zh: 相比之下，SolveBind 保持主干模型不变，并在依赖交互的验证下于运行时协调执行。

sents.en: The distinction concerns the acceptance criterion and execution-control mechanism, rather than whether the task itself is interactive.
sents.zh: 这一区别涉及接受判定标准与执行控制机制，而非任务本身是否具有交互性。

sents.en: Finally, redundant actions and expensive planning or reflection increase end-to-end latency ( Abhyankar et al., 2026 ) , motivating joint evaluation of task success and completion time rather than treating rapid failure as efficient.
sents.zh: 最后，冗余动作以及昂贵的规划或反思会增加端到端延迟（Abhyankar 等，2026），这促使我们联合评估任务成功与完成时间，而不是将快速失败视为高效。

paragraphs.en: Runtime supervision and metareasoning. The separation of action proposals from external control is well established in supervisory control of discrete-event systems ( Ramadge and Wonham, 1987 ) and shielded reinforcement learning ( Alshiekh et al., 2018 ) . We adopt this architectural separation, but not its formal guarantees: admissibility is determined by runtime predicates over accumulated evidence, without guarantees of correctness or non-blocking behavior. Our design rationale instead draws on metareasoning, which weighs computation against its cost and expected value for subsequent decisions ( Horvitz, 2013 ; Russell and Wefald, 1991 ; Zilberstein, 1996 ; Hay et al., 2012 ) , as well as resource-rational accounts of cognition ( Lieder and Griffiths, 2020 ) . These perspectives motivate acting once sufficient evidence is available, revising commitments when their supporting evidence changes, and bounding recovery once further computation is unlikely to improve subsequent decisions. These principles remain empirical design choices rather than consequences of an optimal metareasoning policy. In our ablations (Section 5.4 ), relaxing mediation, fail-safe defaults, or supervision reduces success rates while increasing latency and token usage. Removing only the recovery cap yields slightly higher observed success at substantially greater latency and token usage, supporting bounded recovery as a practical success-cost trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时监督与元推理。 在离散事件系统的监督控制（Ramadge and Wonham, 1987）与受屏蔽的强化学习（Alshiekh et al., 2018）中，将动作提议与外部控制分离的做法已得到充分确立。 我们采纳这种架构上的分离，但不采纳其形式化保证：可采纳性由基于累积证据的运行时谓词决定，不具备正确性或非阻塞行为的保证。 我们的设计理据转而借鉴元推理，即权衡计算与其成本及对后续决策的期望价值（Horvitz, 2013; Russell and Wefald, 1991; Zilberstein, 1996; Hay et al., 2012），以及认知的资源理性解释（Lieder and Griffiths, 2020）。 这些视角促成了如下做法：在获得充分证据后即行动，在其支持证据发生变化时修订承诺，并在进一步计算不太可能改善后续决策时对恢复加以限制。 这些原则仍是经验性的设计选择，而非最优元推理策略所导出的结果。 在我们的消融实验（第 5.4 节）中，放宽中介机制、故障安全默认设置或监督，会降低成功率并增加延迟与令牌用量。 仅移除恢复上限会在延迟与令牌用量大幅增加的情况下带来略高的观测成功率，这支持将有界恢复作为一种实用的成功—成本权衡。

paragraphs.en: We study GUI task execution on websites and applications equipped with human-verification or anti-automation mechanisms. A protected GUI environment is one in which these mechanisms affect whether interactions are accepted and whether the workflow can proceed. Evidence may concern a single action, a local interaction sequence, or a longer history. The mechanisms may use it to assess interaction validity or distinguish human from automated behavior.

paragraphs.en: Given a user goal g g , the agent receives observations o t o_{t} and executes GUI actions a t ∈ 𝒜 GUI a_{t}\in\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{GUI}} . Actions generate execution evidence, such as interaction events and timing, that the protection mechanisms may evaluate. These evaluations can permit continued execution, require renewed verification, or block progress. They therefore form part of the environment dynamics rather than serving only as a terminal check. The agent has access only to observations and feedback exposed by the environment, not to its internal states or undisclosed verification rules.
paragraphs.zh: 给定用户目标 g g，智能体接收观测 o t o_{t} 并执行 GUI 动作 a t ∈ 𝒜 GUI a_{t}\in\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{GUI}}。 动作会生成执行证据，例如交互事件和时间信息，保护机制可以对这些证据进行评估。 这些评估可以允许继续执行、要求重新验证，或阻止进展。 因此，它们构成环境动力学的一部分，而不仅仅是作为终局检查。 智能体只能访问环境所暴露的观测和反馈，而无法访问其内部状态或未公开的验证规则。

paragraphs.en: We assess success jointly with end-to-end wall-clock time,
paragraphs.zh: 我们结合端到端挂钟时间来共同评估成功与否，

paragraphs.en: measured from the first model call until success or failure termination. This interval includes model inference, tool execution, environmental responses, verification, and recovery. We report success jointly with mean latency over all evaluated runs, including failures. A lower all-run mean does not by itself establish faster successful completion, since methods may terminate unsuccessfully or succeed on different task subsets. Appendix A formalizes the trajectories, verification rules, acceptance conditions, and timing comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 从第一次模型调用开始测量，直至以成功或失败终止。 该时间段包括模型推理、工具执行、环境响应、验证与恢复。 我们在报告成功率的同时，报告所有评估运行（包括失败运行）的平均时延。 所有运行的平均时延较低本身并不能证明成功完成得更快，因为各方法可能以失败告终，或在不同任务子集上成功。 附录 A 对轨迹、验证规则、接受条件以及计时比较进行了形式化说明。

paragraphs.en: Protected GUI execution requires deciding whether to continue solving, act on available evidence, or reassess an attempt. Additional computation and evidence gathering may improve the next decision, but both consume execution time. Rational metareasoning weighs the expected decision benefits of computation against its costs ( Russell and Wefald, 1991 ; Hay et al., 2012 ) . We use this perspective to guide three principles for coordinating computation and execution.
paragraphs.zh: 受保护的GUI执行需要决定是继续求解、根据现有证据采取行动，还是重新评估一次尝试。 额外的计算和证据收集可能改善下一个决策，但两者都会消耗执行时间。 理性元推理将计算带来的预期决策收益与其成本进行权衡（Russell and Wefald, 1991；Hay et al., 2012）。 我们利用这一视角来指导协调计算与执行的三个原则。

sents.en: Protected GUI execution requires deciding whether to continue solving, act on available evidence, or reassess an attempt.

sents.zh: 我们利用这一视角来指导协调计算与执行的三个原则。

paragraphs.en: Evidence-grounded commitment. Maintain an evidence-supported operation as a revisable commitment. While its supporting conditions hold and execution constraints are satisfied, let the commitment constrain conflicting proposals and redundant solving. Reconsider it when new observations indicate that relevant conditions have changed.
paragraphs.zh: 以证据为依据的承诺。 将有证据支撑的操作作为一种可修订的承诺加以维持。 当其支持条件成立且执行约束得到满足时，让该承诺约束相互冲突的提议和冗余的求解。 当新的观测表明相关条件已发生变化时，重新审视该承诺。

sents.en: Evidence-grounded commitment.
sents.zh: 以证据为依据的承诺。

sents.en: Maintain an evidence-supported operation as a revisable commitment.
sents.zh: 将有证据支撑的操作作为一种可修订的承诺加以维持。

sents.en: While its supporting conditions hold and execution constraints are satisfied, let the commitment constrain conflicting proposals and redundant solving.

sents.en: Reconsider it when new observations indicate that relevant conditions have changed.
sents.zh: 当新的观测表明相关条件已发生变化时，重新审视该承诺。

paragraphs.en: Progress-checked transition. Advance only when available evidence satisfies the completion criterion for the current capability or the overall task, not merely because an operation has been dispatched. When an outcome remains unresolved, seek evidence that helps determine whether to advance, reassess, or continue observing.
paragraphs.zh: 进度受检的转换。 只有当可用证据满足当前能力或整体任务的完成标准时才推进，而不是仅仅因为某个操作已被派发。 当某个结果尚未确定时，寻找有助于决定是推进、重新评估还是继续观察的证据。

sents.en: Progress-checked transition.
sents.zh: 进度受检的转换。

sents.en: Advance only when available evidence satisfies the completion criterion for the current capability or the overall task, not merely because an operation has been dispatched.

sents.en: When an outcome remains unresolved, seek evidence that helps determine whether to advance, reassess, or continue observing.
sents.zh: 当某个结果尚未确定时，寻找有助于决定是推进、重新评估还是继续观察的证据。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-directed bounded recovery. Use feedback and execution history to revise affected hypotheses and commitments while preserving applicable evidence. Focus recovery on unresolved issues and bound the corresponding recovery operations with explicit budgets. Appendix C develops the rationale and scope of these principles.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈引导的有界恢复。 利用反馈与执行历史修订受影响的假设与承诺，同时保留仍然适用的证据。 将恢复聚焦于未解决的问题，并为相应的恢复操作设定明确的预算上限。 附录C阐述了这些原则的理由与适用范围。

paragraphs.en: SolveBind uses a hierarchical solving tree to organize task-solving capabilities and a runtime supervisor to coordinate execution, progress verification, and recovery. Tool-derived evidence supports concrete, revisable action commitments, while execution feedback updates a shared protocol state that guides subsequent capability selection and dispatch.
paragraphs.zh: SolveBind 使用层级化的求解树来组织任务求解能力，并使用运行时监督者来协调执行、进度验证与恢复。 工具派生的证据支持具体、可修订的行动承诺，而执行反馈会更新一个共享的协议状态，该状态用于指导后续的能力选择与分发。

paragraphs.en: Admissibility requires that the supporting evidence remains valid in the current context, the relevant stage and budget checks pass, and no terminal condition has been triggered. If a proposal conflicts with an admissible commitment, the supervisor replaces it with the committed operation a c a^{c} .

paragraphs.en: Progress verification and bounded recovery. The supervisor assesses outcomes as progress \mathrm{progress} , failure \mathrm{failure} , or unresolved \mathrm{unresolved} using the active stage, execution feedback, and subsequent observations. Progress evidence updates capability status, with advancement permitted once the corresponding completion criterion is satisfied. Failure feedback guides revisions to hypotheses and commitments or the selection of an alternative branch, while unresolved outcomes prompt further observation and feedback acquisition.
paragraphs.zh: 进度验证与有界恢复。 监督者根据当前阶段、执行反馈和后续观察，将结果评估为进度 \mathrm{progress}、失败 \mathrm{failure} 或未解决 \mathrm{unresolved}。 进度证据会更新能力状态，只有满足相应的完成标准后才允许推进。 失败反馈指导对假设和承诺的修订或选择替代分支，而未解决的结果则促使进一步的观察和反馈获取。

sents.en: Progress verification and bounded recovery.
sents.zh: 进度验证与有界恢复。

paragraphs.en: Recovery combines runtime constraints with model guidance, using feedback and attempt history to revise affected hypotheses while preserving applicable evidence. Recovery budgets are consumed in configured units, such as attempts or refreshes. Once a budget is exhausted, the runtime stops the recovery operations within its scope and terminates the run when no permitted continuation remains. Appendix B.4 specifies the feedback categories, state updates, and budget rules.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复机制将运行时约束与模型引导相结合，利用反馈和尝试历史来修订受影响的假设，同时保留仍然适用的证据。 恢复预算按配置的单位消耗，例如尝试次数或刷新次数。 一旦预算耗尽，运行时会停止其范围内的恢复操作，并在不存在任何允许的继续方式时终止本次运行。 附录 B.4 规定了反馈类别、状态更新和预算规则。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SolveBind for reliable and efficient task execution in protected GUI environments from two complementary perspectives: interaction acceptance on the verification side and workflow efficiency on the task side. Appendices D.4 , D.8 , and D.9 provide statistical stability analysis, failure-mode analysis, and case studies, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从两个互补的视角评估 SolveBind 在受保护 GUI 环境中实现可靠且高效的任务执行的能力：验证侧的交互接受度和任务侧的工作流效率。 附录 D.4、D.8 和 D.9 分别提供了统计稳定性分析、失效模式分析和案例研究。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation settings. On the verification side, we evaluate CAPTCHA instances from nine HLL task families with dynamic interaction validation ( Song et al., 2026 ) , using distraction level 2 and hard difficulty where supported, otherwise normal . Success requires both a correct answer and the corresponding interaction evidence. On the task side, we use AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) to assess workflow completion and execution efficiency. Appendices D.1.1 and D.1.5 document the environments, episode initialization, and execution limits.
paragraphs.zh: 评估设置。 在验证方面，我们评估来自九个 HLL 任务族的 CAPTCHA 实例，采用动态交互验证（Song et al., 2026），在支持的情况下使用干扰等级 2 和困难难度，否则使用普通难度。 成功需要同时具备正确答案和相应的交互证据。 在任务方面，我们使用 AndroidWorld（Rawles et al., 2025）来评估工作流完成情况和执行效率。 附录 D.1.1 和 D.1.5 记录了环境、回合初始化和执行限制。

paragraphs.en: Evaluated approaches. We compare SolveBind with the framework-driven MobileAgent ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and AppAgent ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) across foundation models. These harnesses organize execution through planning, tools, memory, and feedback. We also evaluate the released UI-TARS-1.5-7B checkpoint with its native harness ( Qin et al., 2025 ; ByteDance Seed, 2025 ) . We additionally adapt the UI-TARS harness to the same general-purpose foundation models and denote this configuration UI-TARS Harness . Appendices D.1.2 and D.1.3 describe agent integration and information-access boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 已评估的方法。 我们在不同基础模型上将 SolveBind 与框架驱动的 MobileAgent（Wang et al., 2024）和 AppAgent（Zhang et al., 2025）进行比较。 这些测试框架通过规划、工具、记忆和反馈来组织执行。 我们还使用其原生测试框架评估了已发布的 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 检查点（Qin et al., 2025；ByteDance Seed, 2025）。 此外，我们将 UI-TARS 测试框架适配到相同的多用途基础模型上，并将此配置记为 UI-TARS Harness。 附录 D.1.2 和 D.1.3 描述了智能体的集成方式与信息访问边界。

paragraphs.en: Backbone models. We evaluate nine foundation-model backbones on HLL: GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026a ) , Claude Opus 4.8 and 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026b ; Anthropic, 2026a ) , Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , GLM-5V-Turbo ( GLM-V Team, 2026 ) , MiniMax-M2.7 and MiniMax-M3 ( MiniMax, 2026a ; MiniMax, 2026b ) , and Qwen3.7-Plus ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . The AndroidWorld evaluation uses six of these backbones: GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, GLM-5V-Turbo, MiniMax-M3, and Qwen3.7-Plus. UI-TARS-1.5-7B is evaluated separately as a specialized GUI policy rather than counted among these nine backbones.
paragraphs.zh: 主干模型。 我们在 HLL 上评估了九个基础模型主干：GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.4（OpenAI, 2026b；OpenAI, 2026a）、Claude Opus 4.8 和 4.6（Anthropic, 2026b；Anthropic, 2026a）、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview（Google DeepMind, 2026）、GLM-5V-Turbo（GLM-V Team, 2026）、MiniMax-M2.7 和 MiniMax-M3（MiniMax, 2026a；MiniMax, 2026b），以及 Qwen3.7-Plus（Qwen Team, 2026）。 AndroidWorld 评估使用了其中六个主干：GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview、GLM-5V-Turbo、MiniMax-M3 和 Qwen3.7-Plus。 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 作为专门的 GUI 策略被单独评估，而不计入这九个主干之中。

paragraphs.en: Metrics. We report task success rate (SR), end-to-end wall-clock time (E2E), and mean total-token usage (Tok). E2E starts with the first model call and ends at success or failure termination, including model inference, tool calls, GUI operations, environmental responses, and recovery. Tok sums the input and output tokens from all model calls within each task run and averages these totals across runs. Appendix D.1.6 specifies the scored populations and aggregation rules.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。 我们报告任务成功率（SR）、端到端实际耗时（E2E）以及平均总令牌用量（Tok）。 E2E 从第一次模型调用开始，到成功或失败终止结束，包括模型推理、工具调用、GUI 操作、环境响应以及恢复过程。 Tok 将每次任务运行中所有模型调用的输入和输出令牌数相加，并对多次运行的总数取平均。 附录 D.1.6 规定了参与统计的样本范围和聚合规则。

Appendix D.2 provides per-backbone success gaps and unscaled token results.

paragraphs.en: Higher verification success with lower latency. Relative to MobileAgent, GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview improve SR while reducing mean E2E. GPT-5.5 reduces E2E from 167.3 to 112.0 seconds, a 33.05% reduction. Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview reduces E2E from 577.7 to 88.6 seconds, an 84.66% reduction, while increasing success by 34.5 percentage points based on the displayed SR values. Token usage increases for GPT-5.5 but decreases for Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and Qwen3.7-Plus. Lower latency is therefore not uniformly accompanied by lower token usage.
paragraphs.zh: 更高的验证成功率与更低的时延。 相对于 MobileAgent，GPT-5.5 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 在提升 SR 的同时降低了平均 E2E。 GPT-5.5 将 E2E 从 167.3 秒降至 112.0 秒，降幅为 33.05%。 根据所展示的 SR 值，Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 将 E2E 从 577.7 秒降至 88.6 秒，降幅达 84.66%，同时成功率提升了 34.5 个百分点。 GPT-5.5 的 token 用量增加，而 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 和 Qwen3.7-Plus 的 token 用量减少。 因此，更低的时延并不总是伴随着更低的 token 用量。

paragraphs.en: GUI specialization alone does not remove the verification bottleneck. UI-TARS-1.5-7B with its native harness completes 325 of 900 tasks in the full evaluation, achieving 36.11% success and leaving 575 tasks unsuccessful. Thus, a policy specialized for GUI operation still encounters a substantial completion bottleneck under difficult, high-distraction verification conditions. Solving, interaction evidence, and feedback coordination remain central to translating GUI capabilities into successful protected execution. Appendix D.3 and Appendix D.6 report the native-policy evaluation separately from the backbone–harness comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠 GUI 专项化并不能消除验证瓶颈。 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 在其原生框架下，在完整评测的 900 个任务中完成了 325 个，成功率为 36.11%，仍有 575 个任务未成功。 因此，面向 GUI 操作专项化的策略，在困难且高干扰的验证条件下仍会遇到显著的完成瓶颈。 求解、交互证据与反馈协调，仍是将 GUI 能力转化为成功的受保护执行的核心所在。 附录 D.3 和附录 D.6 将原生策略评测与主干—框架对比分开报告。

paragraphs.en: Correct answers can still fail dynamic verification. A paired diagnostic analysis of 90 HLL tasks with GPT-5.5 identifies 13 MobileAgent episodes (14.44%) whose submitted answers pass the static correctness check but are rejected by the dynamic validator and end in failure. SolveBind succeeds on seven of these same tasks (7/13, 53.85%). Across the full diagnostic panel, 13 tasks change from MobileAgent failure to SolveBind success, while one changes in the opposite direction, a net gain of 12/90 or 13.33 percentage points. This establishes the presence of the targeted failure mode and paired improvement on affected tasks. Appendix D.5 details the classification and counts.
paragraphs.zh: 正确答案仍可能无法通过动态验证。 对 90 个 HLL 任务与 GPT-5.5 进行的成对诊断分析，识别出 13 个 MobileAgent 轨迹（14.44%），其提交的答案通过了静态正确性检查，却被动态验证器拒绝并以失败告终。 SolveBind 在其中七个相同任务上取得成功（7/13，53.85%）。 在整个诊断面板中，有 13 个任务从 MobileAgent 失败变为 SolveBind 成功，而有一个任务朝相反方向变化，净增益为 12/90，即 13.33 个百分点。 这证实了目标失败模式的存在，以及受影响任务上的成对改进。 附录 D.5 详细说明了分类与数量。

paragraphs.en: The shared runtime reduces task-side execution costs. Relative to MobileAgent, SolveBind reduces mean E2E by 68.47%–80.01% and mean total-token usage by 41.86%–59.56% across the six AndroidWorld backbones. It also attains higher success on every backbone in this comparison. With GPT-5.5, E2E decreases from 838.03 to 196.88 seconds and success rises from 40.52% to 72.4%. With Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, E2E decreases from 1008.0 to 272.96 seconds and success rises from 31.03% to 61.2%. These results support the applicability of the shared runtime to general application workflows. Appendix D.2.2 gives the extended comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 共享运行时降低了任务侧的执行成本。 相对于 MobileAgent，SolveBind 在六个 AndroidWorld 骨干模型上将平均 E2E 降低了 68.47%–80.01%，将平均总 token 用量降低了 41.86%–59.56%。 在此比较中，它还在每个骨干模型上都取得了更高的成功率。 使用 GPT-5.5 时，E2E 从 838.03 秒降至 196.88 秒，成功率从 40.52% 提升至 72.4%。 使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 时，E2E 从 1008.0 秒降至 272.96 秒，成功率从 31.03% 提升至 61.2%。 这些结果支持了共享运行时在通用应用工作流中的适用性。 附录 D.2.2 给出了扩展比较。

paragraphs.en: Fast termination alone does not imply efficient completion. Relative to AppAgent, GPT-5.5 improves success by 37.1 percentage points based on the displayed SR values while reducing E2E by 30.23%; GLM-5v-turbo also improves both success and E2E. With Claude Opus 4.8, higher success is accompanied by both higher E2E and greater total-token usage. With MiniMax-M3, E2E is lower, although total-token usage is higher. The native UI-TARS-1.5-7B system averages 95.24 seconds and 14,018.81 tokens, but completes 23 of 116 tasks. These comparisons show why short outputs and short runs must be considered together with task completion. SolveBind improves completion rates and, in multiple system comparisons, reduces the time required for task execution.

Because automatic submission is unchanged, this comparison isolates the contribution of binding in this configuration.

paragraphs.en: Weaker runtime control reduces success while increasing cost. Bypassing mediation lowers success by 9.33 percentage points, while jointly relaxing binding and submission lowers it by 13.78 points. Removing fail-safe defaults reduces success by 7.11 points and produces the largest cost increase, adding 46.00 seconds and 18,818 tokens per run. These results support coordinating execution with available evidence rather than allowing unconstrained dispatch.

paragraphs.en: We studied GUI task execution in protected environments , where goal achievement and environmental acceptance are distinct. SolveBind combines a hierarchical solving tree with a runtime supervisor that treats tool outputs as revisable evidence, binds them to action commitments, mediates dispatch, and budgets recovery by category. Across evaluated backbones, it improves success in most verification settings and all AndroidWorld comparisons while reducing latency in several cases. A paired GPT-5.5 diagnostic further suggests gains when agents find correct solutions but fail to execute them acceptably, although improvements are not uniform. Our verification evaluation uses recorded interaction evidence rather than production detectors, while AndroidWorld measures general workflow execution. Extending these results to deployed protections and identifying the backbone properties underlying runtime supervision remain future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了受保护环境中的 GUI 任务执行，在该环境中，目标达成与环境接受是两个不同的概念。 SolveBind 将分层求解树与运行时监督器相结合，该监督器把工具输出视为可修订的证据，将其绑定到动作承诺，调解分发，并按类别为恢复分配预算。 在所有被评估的骨干模型上，它在大多数验证设置和所有 AndroidWorld 对比中都提高了成功率，同时在若干情况下降低了延迟。 一项配对的 GPT-5.5 诊断进一步表明，当智能体找到正确解决方案却无法以可接受的方式执行时，会有所提升，尽管改进并不均匀。 我们的验证评估使用的是记录的交互证据而非生产级检测器，而 AndroidWorld 衡量的是一般工作流执行。 将这些结果扩展到已部署的防护机制，并识别运行时监督背后的骨干模型特性，仍是未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: This work evaluates GUI agents in protected environments with CAPTCHA and behavioral anti-automation checks. All experiments are conducted in controlled settings using the locally deployed HLL verification environments and the AndroidWorld simulator; no real third-party websites, production verification systems, or user data are involved. Our goal is to study the gap between solving a verification challenge and satisfying environmental checks, not to bypass deployed protections. We acknowledge that techniques improving interaction success could potentially be misused against real anti-automation systems. Our evaluation relies only on interaction evidence recorded by HLL rather than production detectors. The implementation will be released upon acceptance. The authors declare no competing interests.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作在受保护环境中评估GUI智能体，这些环境包含CAPTCHA以及行为反自动化检测。 所有实验均在受控环境中进行，使用本地部署的HLL验证环境和AndroidWorld模拟器；不涉及任何真实的第三方网站、生产环境验证系统或用户数据。 我们的目标是研究解决验证挑战与满足环境检测之间的差距，而非绕过已部署的防护措施。 我们承认，提升交互成功率的技术可能被滥用于对抗真实的反自动化系统。 我们的评估仅依赖HLL记录的交互证据，而非生产环境检测器。 实现将在论文被接收后发布。 作者声明无利益冲突。

paragraphs.en: Local outcomes v t ( j ) v_{t}^{(j)} and overall acceptance have different roles. A local rejection can leave the task open to correction, while a local pass need not satisfy later verification requirements. paragraphs.en: The interval covers model inference, tool calls, runtime control, GUI execution, environmental responses, verification, and recovery. It is measured as elapsed wall-clock time, not a sum of component durations that might overlap. For an execution stopped by an external cutoff, the interval ends at the actual cutoff; it does not estimate the unobserved time to eventual success. Failure and cutoff runs retain their elapsed time and termination status.

paragraphs.en: The expectation is over task instances and any randomness in the agent and environment. All-run latency includes failed executions; successful-run latency describes only completed tasks and is undefined when there are no successes. Because methods may succeed on different task subsets, their conditional means do not alone establish a speedup on the same workload. Timing comparisons must identify the population being compared and report success rates and termination conditions alongside latency.
paragraphs.zh: 期望是对任务实例以及智能体和环境中的任何随机性求取的。 全部运行延迟包括失败的执行；成功运行延迟仅描述已完成的任务，当没有成功时该指标无定义。 由于各方法可能在不同的任务子集上成功，它们的条件均值本身并不能证明在相同工作负载上有加速。 时间比较必须指明被比较的总体，并在报告延迟的同时报告成功率和终止条件。

paragraphs.en: The result pass refers only to the checks the interface supports, not an exhaustive test of evidence truth. paragraphs.en: Evidence can support several decisions, but a pending commitment records one specific executable continuation. This relationship distinguishes supplying a tool result as model context from having the runtime enforce the operation that the result supports.

paragraphs.en: A new challenge, a changed target region, an unavailable object, or feedback contradicting the current solution can trigger reassessment of dependent commitments. Content rejection can undermine a solution hypothesis without invalidating every geometric observation; a changed page can invalidate geometry while leaving the high-level goal intact. Budget exhaustion restricts execution but does not itself make evidence false. The checks supported by the interface determine which changes can be detected; the protocol does not assume an oracle for all visual changes.
paragraphs.zh: 新的挑战、目标区域的变化、对象不可用，或与当前解决方案相矛盾的反馈，都可能触发对相关承诺的重新评估。 内容被拒绝可能推翻一个解决方案假设，但并不会使所有几何观察失效；页面发生变化可能使几何信息失效，而高层目标仍然保持不变。 预算耗尽会限制执行，但其本身并不会使证据变为虚假。 界面所支持的检查决定了哪些变化能够被检测到；该协议并不假设存在能识别所有视觉变化的先知机制。

paragraphs.en: The commitment lifecycle has four logically distinct situations:
paragraphs.zh: 承诺生命周期包含四个逻辑上不同的情形：

paragraphs.en: Unbound. Evidence is insufficient to establish the next committed operation. The model can propose relevant evidence acquisition or another permitted operation.
paragraphs.zh: 未绑定。 证据不足以确定下一个已提交的操作。 模型可以提出获取相关证据或另一个被允许的操作。

sents.en: Unbound.
sents.zh: 未绑定。

sents.en: Evidence is insufficient to establish the next committed operation.
sents.zh: 证据不足以确定下一个已提交的操作。

sents.en: The model can propose relevant evidence acquisition or another permitted operation.
sents.zh: 模型可以提出获取相关证据或另一个被允许的操作。

paragraphs.en: Pending. Actionable evidence establishes c k c_{k} . In the full-control configuration, a still-admissible commitment takes precedence over a conflicting proposal.
paragraphs.zh: 待定。 可行动的证据确立 c k c_{k} 。 在完全控制配置下，仍然可采纳的承诺优先于与之冲突的提案。

sents.en: Pending.
sents.zh: 待定。

sents.en: Actionable evidence establishes c k c_{k} .
sents.zh: 可行动的证据确立 c k c_{k} 。

sents.en: In the full-control configuration, a still-admissible commitment takes precedence over a conflicting proposal.
sents.zh: 在完全控制配置下，仍然可采纳的承诺优先于与之冲突的提案。

paragraphs.en: Dispatched, outcome unresolved. The operation has been issued and is no longer pending for repetition. Its effect still requires assessment through feedback or observation.
paragraphs.zh: 已分派，结果尚未确定。 该操作已发出，不再处于等待重复的状态。 其效果仍需通过反馈或观察进行评估。

sents.en: Dispatched, outcome unresolved.
sents.zh: 已分派，结果尚未确定。

sents.en: The operation has been issued and is no longer pending for repetition.
sents.zh: 该操作已发出，不再处于等待重复的状态。

sents.en: Its effect still requires assessment through feedback or observation.
sents.zh: 其效果仍需通过反馈或观察进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Resolved or reconsidered. Progress supports advancement; failure or changed support motivates revising the hypothesis, reacquiring evidence, or recovering within budget.
paragraphs.zh: 已解决或重新考虑。 进展支持推进；失败或支持的变化会促使修订假设、重新获取证据，或在预算内进行恢复。

sents.en: Resolved or reconsidered.
sents.zh: 已解决或重新考虑。

sents.en: Progress supports advancement; failure or changed support motivates revising the hypothesis, reacquiring evidence, or recovering within budget.
sents.zh: 进展支持推进；失败或支持的变化会促使修订假设、重新获取证据，或在预算内进行恢复。

paragraphs.en: These are semantic distinctions rather than four required implementation flags. Consuming the pending status and recording an attempt must preserve the information needed for outcome verification.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是语义上的区分，而不是四个必须实现的标志位。 消费待定状态并记录一次尝试时，必须保留结果验证所需的信息。

sents.en: These are semantic distinctions rather than four required implementation flags.
sents.zh: 这些是语义上的区分，而不是四个必须实现的标志位。

sents.en: Consuming the pending status and recording an attempt must preserve the information needed for outcome verification.
sents.zh: 消费待定状态并记录一次尝试时，必须保留结果验证所需的信息。

paragraphs.en: For the controller in Eq. 24 , replacing a proposal is justified by a currently admissible commitment, not merely by an old pending record. Admissibility assessment must incorporate the latest accessible feedback. A commitment cannot override terminal conditions or violated enforced constraints. When its support no longer holds, it loses its basis for execution precedence, and the runtime reconsiders the continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于式 24 中的控制器而言，替换一个提案的依据是当前可采纳的承诺，而不仅仅是某条过期的待定记录。 可采纳性评估必须纳入最新可获取的反馈。 承诺不能覆盖终止条件或已被违反的强制性约束。 当其支持不再成立时，它便失去执行优先级的依据，运行时会重新考虑后续的延续。

sents.en: For the controller in Eq. 24 , replacing a proposal is justified by a currently admissible commitment, not merely by an old pending record.
sents.zh: 对于式 24 中的控制器而言，替换一个提案的依据是当前可采纳的承诺，而不仅仅是某条过期的待定记录。

sents.en: Admissibility assessment must incorporate the latest accessible feedback.
sents.zh: 可采纳性评估必须纳入最新可获取的反馈。

sents.en: A commitment cannot override terminal conditions or violated enforced constraints.
sents.zh: 承诺不能覆盖终止条件或已被违反的强制性约束。

sents.en: When its support no longer holds, it loses its basis for execution precedence, and the runtime reconsiders the continuation.
sents.zh: 当其支持不再成立时，它便失去执行优先级的依据，运行时会重新考虑后续的延续。

paragraphs.en: Rejecting a proposal, deferring an interaction, and initiating recovery need not each produce a new GUI action. A rejected proposal can be withheld; a deferred GUI interaction can be replaced by a grounding or verification request; recovery can revise the active capability before the next interaction is selected. A hold \mathrm{hold} decision dispatches no request, so active evidence acquisition must be selected as an operation in 𝒜 \mathcal{A} . All dispatched replacements remain subject to applicable checks. These dependencies do not require every implementation to use the same ordered list of conditional branches.
paragraphs.zh: 拒绝一项提案、推迟一次交互以及启动恢复，各自并不一定都会产生一个新的GUI动作。 被拒绝的提案可以不予执行；被推迟的GUI交互可以替换为一次接地或验证请求；恢复可以在选择下一次交互之前修订当前激活的能力。 保持 \mathrm{hold} 决策不会派发任何请求，因此主动的证据获取必须被选为 𝒜 \mathcal{A} 中的一个操作。 所有被派发的替换操作仍需接受适用的检查。 这些依赖关系并不要求每个实现都使用相同的条件分支有序列表。

sents.zh: 拒绝一项提案、推迟一次交互以及启动恢复，各自并不一定都会产生一个新的GUI动作。

sents.en: A rejected proposal can be withheld; a deferred GUI interaction can be replaced by a grounding or verification request; recovery can revise the active capability before the next interaction is selected.
sents.zh: 被拒绝的提案可以不予执行；被推迟的GUI交互可以替换为一次接地或验证请求；恢复可以在选择下一次交互之前修订当前激活的能力。

sents.zh: 保持 \mathrm{hold} 决策不会派发任何请求，因此主动的证据获取必须被选为 𝒜 \mathcal{A} 中的一个操作。

sents.en: All dispatched replacements remain subject to applicable checks.
sents.zh: 所有被派发的替换操作仍需接受适用的检查。

sents.en: These dependencies do not require every implementation to use the same ordered list of conditional branches.
sents.zh: 这些依赖关系并不要求每个实现都使用相同的条件分支有序列表。

paragraphs.en: The same proposal can lead to different decisions in different states. An admissible pending commitment can replace repeated localization, whereas changed page conditions can make that localization necessary again. Proposal identity alone is therefore insufficient to determine the runtime response.
paragraphs.zh: 同一提案在不同的状态下可能导致不同的决策。 一个可接受的待定提交可以替代重复的定位，而页面条件的变化则可能使该定位再次成为必要。 因此，仅凭提案身份本身不足以确定运行时的响应。

sents.en: The same proposal can lead to different decisions in different states.
sents.zh: 同一提案在不同的状态下可能导致不同的决策。

sents.en: An admissible pending commitment can replace repeated localization, whereas changed page conditions can make that localization necessary again.
sents.zh: 一个可接受的待定提交可以替代重复的定位，而页面条件的变化则可能使该定位再次成为必要。

sents.en: Proposal identity alone is therefore insufficient to determine the runtime response.
sents.zh: 因此，仅凭提案身份本身不足以确定运行时的响应。

paragraphs.en: For nonterminal decisions, the runtime assesses outcomes using the active stage, protocol state, actual decision, and subsequent accessible feedback:
paragraphs.zh: 对于非终结性决策，运行时会使用当前活跃阶段、协议状态、实际决策以及后续可访问的反馈来评估结果：

paragraphs.en: Here, f k f_{k} is the feedback accessible after the decision, and o ¯ k + 1 \bar{o}_{k+1} is the latest available observation. The categories represent evidence of progress, evidence against the current attempt, and a lack of decisive evidence. They need not be literal labels returned by the implementation or environment. An unresolved outcome is not a success, and a visible change need not constitute useful progress; completion signals must match the active capability or task criterion. Runtime outcome verification assesses accessible evidence; it does not replace the environment’s protection checks or guarantee environmental acceptance.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，f k f_{k} 是决策之后可获取的反馈，o ¯ k + 1 \bar{o}_{k+1} 是最新的可用观测。 这些类别分别代表进展的证据、反对当前尝试的证据，以及缺乏决定性证据的情况。 它们不必是具体实现或环境所返回的字面标签。 未决的结果不是成功，可见的变化也不一定构成有用的进展；完成信号必须与当前生效的能力或任务标准相匹配。 运行时结果验证评估的是可获取的证据；它不能替代环境的保护性检查，也不能保证环境会接受结果。

sents.en: Here, f k f_{k} is the feedback accessible after the decision, and o ¯ k + 1 \bar{o}_{k+1} is the latest available observation.
sents.zh: 其中，f k f_{k} 是决策之后可获取的反馈，o ¯ k + 1 \bar{o}_{k+1} 是最新的可用观测。

sents.en: They need not be literal labels returned by the implementation or environment.
sents.zh: 它们不必是具体实现或环境所返回的字面标签。

sents.zh: 运行时结果验证评估的是可获取的证据；它不能替代环境的保护性检查，也不能保证环境会接受结果。

paragraphs.en: Equation 25 couples updates to the stage, evidence, commitment, outcome history, and budgets. An operation can consume a commitment without completing the goal; rejection can revise a hypothesis without abandoning the task; and a tool call can produce evidence without changing the GUI. A single generic success flag cannot represent these distinctions.
paragraphs.zh: 公式25将更新与阶段、证据、承诺、结果历史和预算耦合在一起。 一个操作可以在不完成目标的情况下消耗承诺；拒绝可以在不放弃任务的情况下修正假设；而一次工具调用可以在不改变GUI的情况下产生证据。 单一的通用成功标志无法表达这些区别。

sents.en: Equation 25 couples updates to the stage, evidence, commitment, outcome history, and budgets.
sents.zh: 公式25将更新与阶段、证据、承诺、结果历史和预算耦合在一起。

sents.en: An operation can consume a commitment without completing the goal; rejection can revise a hypothesis without abandoning the task; and a tool call can produce evidence without changing the GUI.
sents.zh: 一个操作可以在不完成目标的情况下消耗承诺；拒绝可以在不放弃任务的情况下修正假设；而一次工具调用可以在不改变GUI的情况下产生证据。

sents.en: A single generic success flag cannot represent these distinctions.
sents.zh: 单一的通用成功标志无法表达这些区别。

paragraphs.en: Explicit environment responses can supply rejection categories. Other conditions, such as missing progress or repeated evidence, can be inferred from observations and history. The protocol does not assume access to hidden ground-truth failure causes. Branch selection combines runtime constraints with model reasoning guided by feedback and history. Shared state therefore constrains and guides recovery rather than hard-masking every unsuitable branch.
paragraphs.zh: 显式的环境响应可以提供拒绝类别。 其他条件，例如没有进展或证据重复，可以从观察和历史中推断得出。 该协议不假设能够访问隐藏的真实失败原因。 分支选择将运行时约束与由反馈和历史引导的模型推理相结合。 因此，共享状态是对恢复进行约束和引导，而不是硬性屏蔽每一个不合适的分支。

sents.en: Explicit environment responses can supply rejection categories.
sents.zh: 显式的环境响应可以提供拒绝类别。

sents.en: Other conditions, such as missing progress or repeated evidence, can be inferred from observations and history.
sents.zh: 其他条件，例如没有进展或证据重复，可以从观察和历史中推断得出。

sents.en: The protocol does not assume access to hidden ground-truth failure causes.
sents.zh: 该协议不假设能够访问隐藏的真实失败原因。

sents.en: Branch selection combines runtime constraints with model reasoning guided by feedback and history.
sents.zh: 分支选择将运行时约束与由反馈和历史引导的模型推理相结合。

paragraphs.en: Only GUI actions that are actually dispatched enter the environment interaction record defined in Section 3.1 . A tool may return evidence alone or also execute GUI interactions, so tool calls and environment interactions need not correspond one-to-one. Thus, k k indexes runtime decisions rather than a fixed number of low-level GUI events.
paragraphs.zh: 只有实际分发的GUI操作才会进入3.1节定义的环境交互记录。 工具可以仅返回证据，也可以同时执行GUI交互，因此工具调用与环境交互不必一一对应。 因此，k k 索引的是运行时决策，而非固定数量的底层GUI事件。

paragraphs.en: These interfaces yield the following logical cycle, whose steps need not correspond one-to-one to software functions or model calls:
paragraphs.zh: 这些接口形成了以下逻辑循环，其步骤不必与软件函数或模型调用一一对应：

paragraphs.en: Read the execution context. Use the state incorporating accessible observations and prior feedback to inspect current evidence, stage status, commitments, outcome history, and budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 读取执行上下文。 利用整合了可访问观察结果与先前反馈的状态，检查当前证据、阶段状态、承诺、结果历史和预算。

sents.en: Read the execution context.
sents.zh: 读取执行上下文。

sents.en: Use the state incorporating accessible observations and prior feedback to inspect current evidence, stage status, commitments, outcome history, and budgets.
sents.zh: 利用整合了可访问观察结果与先前反馈的状态，检查当前证据、阶段状态、承诺、结果历史和预算。

paragraphs.en: Form a candidate continuation. Select and refine a proposal using the task capability structure and the permitted model view. A tool-supported pending commitment remains available to the runtime even when the model proposes another operation.
paragraphs.zh: 形成一个候选延续。 基于任务能力结构和允许的模型视图，选择并完善一个提案。 即使智能体提出另一个操作，由工具支持的待定承诺在运行时仍然可用。

sents.en: Form a candidate continuation.
sents.zh: 形成一个候选延续。

sents.en: Select and refine a proposal using the task capability structure and the permitted model view.
sents.zh: 基于任务能力结构和允许的模型视图，选择并完善一个提案。

sents.en: A tool-supported pending commitment remains available to the runtime even when the model proposes another operation.
sents.zh: 即使智能体提出另一个操作，由工具支持的待定承诺在运行时仍然可用。

paragraphs.en: Resolve execution. Check terminal conditions and applicable constraints, reassess commitments, and accept, replace, or withhold the proposal. Missing evidence can lead to evidence acquisition rather than an interaction that directly changes task state.
paragraphs.zh: 解析执行。 检查终止条件和适用的约束条件，重新评估承诺，然后接受、替换或搁置该提案。 证据缺失可能导致进行证据获取，而不是直接改变任务状态的交互。

sents.en: Resolve execution.
sents.zh: 解析执行。

sents.en: Check terminal conditions and applicable constraints, reassess commitments, and accept, replace, or withhold the proposal.
sents.zh: 检查终止条件和适用的约束条件，重新评估承诺，然后接受、替换或搁置该提案。

sents.en: Missing evidence can lead to evidence acquisition rather than an interaction that directly changes task state.
sents.zh: 证据缺失可能导致进行证据获取，而不是直接改变任务状态的交互。

paragraphs.en: Dispatch and obtain the outcome. Execute only the selected request, retain its supporting context, and obtain feedback while distinguishing execution status from task progress.
paragraphs.zh: 进行分发并获取结果。 仅执行所选请求，保留其支撑上下文，并在获取反馈的同时区分执行状态与任务进度。

sents.en: Dispatch and obtain the outcome.
sents.zh: 进行分发并获取结果。

sents.en: Execute only the selected request, retain its supporting context, and obtain feedback while distinguishing execution status from task progress.
sents.zh: 仅执行所选请求，保留其支撑上下文，并在获取反馈的同时区分执行状态与任务进度。

paragraphs.en: Update state and advance or recover. Use the outcome to update the protocol state, advance a capability, revise a commitment, acquire evidence, or choose a bounded recovery direction, then continue or terminate.
paragraphs.zh: 更新状态并推进或恢复。 利用该结果更新协议状态、推进某项能力、修订某个承诺、获取证据，或选择一个有界的恢复方向，然后继续或终止。

sents.en: Update state and advance or recover.
sents.zh: 更新状态并推进或恢复。

sents.en: Use the outcome to update the protocol state, advance a capability, revise a commitment, acquire evidence, or choose a bounded recovery direction, then continue or terminate.
sents.zh: 利用该结果更新协议状态、推进某项能力、修订某个承诺、获取证据，或选择一个有界的恢复方向，然后继续或终止。

paragraphs.en: The cycle connects model proposals, runtime dispatch, and subsequent outcome evidence rather than introducing an additional search algorithm. Logical binding does not imply that every continuation saves a model call; call scheduling and binding are distinct concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 该循环将模型提议、运行时分发以及后续结果证据连接起来，而不是引入额外的搜索算法。 逻辑绑定并不意味着每个延续都能节省一次模型调用；调用调度与绑定是两个不同的问题。

paragraphs.en: Suppose a grounding or solving tool returns a candidate displacement whose evidence supports a drag commitment. After dispatch, exposed feedback indicating content rejection leaves the high-level goal unfinished and provides evidence against the attempted displacement. Corrective grounding or solving can produce a revised displacement and a new commitment, and the subsequent interaction is verified. This example illustrates selective evidence retention and commitment revision, not a benchmark result or a controlled comparison with another agent.
paragraphs.zh: 假设一个落地或求解工具返回一个候选置换，其证据支持一个拖拽承诺。 分发之后，暴露的指示内容被拒绝的反馈使高层目标保持未完成状态，并提供了反对该尝试置换的证据。 纠正性的落地或求解可以产生一个修订后的置换和新的承诺，随后的交互得到验证。 本示例说明的是选择性证据保留与承诺修订，而非一个基准测试结果或与另一个智能体的受控比较。

paragraphs.en: For a settings-change task, the adapter supplies the desired setting and an observable completion criterion. Perception identifies the relevant page, grounding identifies the control, evidence supports an operation on that control, and verification checks whether the desired state is observed. A page change before dispatch or an unclear effect prompts renewed evidence acquisition or further observation. The reusable structure is the dependency between evidence, commitment, execution, and verification; the target and concrete checks remain task-specific. This example does not report a completed task from a particular benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 对于设置更改任务，适配器提供期望的设置以及可观察的完成判据。 感知识别相关页面，定位确定控件，证据支持对该控件执行操作，而验证则检查是否观察到了期望的状态。 如果在派发前页面发生变化，或效果不明确，则会触发重新获取证据或进一步观察。 可复用的结构是证据、承诺、执行与验证之间的依赖关系；而目标与具体检查仍是任务相关的。 本示例并不报告来自某个特定基准的已完成任务。

paragraphs.en: Repeated interactions may still fail to produce useful progress when feedback is ambiguous or model-guided recovery selects poorly. A submission may be deferred because prerequisites are unavailable, yet the run can still end at a cutoff. Enforcing execution constraints does not provide a solver that always reaches the goal. Incorrect tool evidence and excessive control overhead can also offset the intended benefits.
paragraphs.zh: 当反馈含糊不清或模型引导的恢复选择不当时，反复交互仍可能无法产生有用的进展。 提交可能会因前置条件不可用而被推迟，但运行仍可在截止点结束。 强制执行执行约束并不能提供一个总能达成目标的求解器。 错误的工具证据和过度的控制开销也可能抵消预期的收益。

sents.en: Repeated interactions may still fail to produce useful progress when feedback is ambiguous or model-guided recovery selects poorly.
sents.zh: 当反馈含糊不清或模型引导的恢复选择不当时，反复交互仍可能无法产生有用的进展。

sents.zh: 提交可能会因前置条件不可用而被推迟，但运行仍可在截止点结束。

paragraphs.en: Measured case studies should retain the initial context, model proposal, supporting evidence, runtime decision and reason, actual operation, feedback, state change, and final outcome. Operation-name normalization alone does not demonstrate semantic correction. Likewise, two trajectories do not establish a causal comparison without aligned task instances, information access, and execution conditions. Illustrative protocol examples and measured cases in the experimental appendix are therefore presented separately.
paragraphs.zh: 实测案例应保留初始上下文、模型提案、支持证据、运行时决策及其理由、实际操作、反馈、状态变化和最终结果。 仅凭操作名称的规范化并不能证明语义上的正确性。 同样，在没有对齐的任务实例、信息访问和执行条件的情况下，两条轨迹也不能构成因果比较。 因此，实验附录中的协议示例与实测案例分别呈现。

sents.zh: 实测案例应保留初始上下文、模型提案、支持证据、运行时决策及其理由、实际操作、反馈、状态变化和最终结果。

paragraphs.en: This appendix expands the design principles in Section 3.2 . Rational metareasoning provides a perspective on allocating processing effort; the concrete execution mechanisms are specified in Section 4 and Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录对第 3.2 节中的设计原则进行扩展。 理性元推理为分配处理算力提供了一种视角；具体的执行机制在第 4 节和附录 B 中给出。

sents.en: This appendix expands the design principles in Section 3.2 .
sents.zh: 本附录对第 3.2 节中的设计原则进行扩展。

sents.en: Rational metareasoning provides a perspective on allocating processing effort; the concrete execution mechanisms are specified in Section 4 and Appendix B .
sents.zh: 理性元推理为分配处理算力提供了一种视角；具体的执行机制在第 4 节和附录 B 中给出。

paragraphs.en: Rational metareasoning distinguishes the choice of external actions from the choice of computations that inform those actions. A computation is valuable insofar as its expected contribution to subsequent decision quality justifies its cost ( Russell and Wefald, 1991 ) . This perspective addresses both which computations to perform and when to stop deliberating and act. For example, Hay et al. (2012) formulate computation selection as a metalevel decision problem in which computational outcomes inform the eventual choice of an external action. Performing more computation is therefore not an objective in itself.
paragraphs.zh: 理性元推理将外部动作的选择与为这些动作提供依据的计算的选择区分开来。 一项计算的价值在于，其对后续决策质量的预期贡献能否抵消其成本（Russell and Wefald, 1991）。 这一视角既涉及执行哪些计算，也涉及何时停止思考并采取行动。例如，Hay 等人 （2012）将计算选择表述为一个元层决策问题，其中计算结果为最终选择外部动作提供依据。 因此，执行更多计算本身并不是目标。

sents.en: Rational metareasoning distinguishes the choice of external actions from the choice of computations that inform those actions.
sents.zh: 理性元推理将外部动作的选择与为这些动作提供依据的计算的选择区分开来。

sents.en: A computation is valuable insofar as its expected contribution to subsequent decision quality justifies its cost ( Russell and Wefald, 1991 ) .
sents.zh: 一项计算的价值在于，其对后续决策质量的预期贡献能否抵消其成本（Russell and Wefald, 1991）。

sents.en: This perspective addresses both which computations to perform and when to stop deliberating and act. For example, Hay et al.
sents.zh: 这一视角既涉及执行哪些计算，也涉及何时停止思考并采取行动。例如，Hay 等人

sents.en: (2012) formulate computation selection as a metalevel decision problem in which computational outcomes inform the eventual choice of an external action.
sents.zh: （2012）将计算选择表述为一个元层决策问题，其中计算结果为最终选择外部动作提供依据。

sents.en: Performing more computation is therefore not an objective in itself.
sents.zh: 因此，执行更多计算本身并不是目标。

paragraphs.en: We borrow this benefit–cost perspective for model reasoning, tool-based solving, evidence acquisition, and outcome verification. These activities contribute to end-to-end latency, and their usefulness depends on how they support subsequent execution. They are not all purely internal computations: obtaining an observation may require an environment interaction, and a tool may both return information and execute GUI actions. We therefore retain the distinction between tool invocations and realized interactions, rather than identify every tool call with a metalevel computational action. The corresponding runtime interfaces and execution rules are described in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们借用这种收益–成本视角来看待模型推理、基于工具的求解、证据获取和结果验证。 这些活动会影响端到端延迟，其有用性取决于它们对后续执行的支持程度。 它们并非都是纯粹的内部计算：获取一次观察可能需要与环境交互，而一个工具既可能返回信息，也可能执行图形界面操作。 因此，我们保留工具调用与实际发生的交互之间的区别，而不是把每一次工具调用都等同于一个元层计算动作。 相应的运行时接口与执行规则在附录 B 中描述。

sents.en: The corresponding runtime interfaces and execution rules are described in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 相应的运行时接口与执行规则在附录 B 中描述。

paragraphs.en: Reliable and efficient execution depends not only on answer correctness, but also on when to acquire information, act on an available solution, and revise an attempt after feedback. Additional reasoning and checks can improve execution decisions, but also incur latency. Acting prematurely can lead to rejection or rework, whereas repeatedly revisiting an already-supported solution can add cost without improving the next decision. The design objective is thus to coordinate these activities, rather than maximize reasoning effort or minimize interaction count in isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠且高效的执行不仅取决于答案的正确性，还取决于何时获取信息、何时采用现有方案以及何时在获得反馈后修改尝试。 额外的推理和检查可以改进执行决策，但也会带来延迟。 过早行动可能导致方案被拒绝或返工，而反复重新审视一个已有充分依据的方案则可能增加成本却无助于改进下一次决策。 因此，设计目标是协调这些活动，而不是孤立地最大化推理投入或最小化交互次数。

sents.en: Reliable and efficient execution depends not only on answer correctness, but also on when to acquire information, act on an available solution, and revise an attempt after feedback.
sents.zh: 可靠且高效的执行不仅取决于答案的正确性，还取决于何时获取信息、何时采用现有方案以及何时在获得反馈后修改尝试。

sents.en: Additional reasoning and checks can improve execution decisions, but also incur latency.
sents.zh: 额外的推理和检查可以改进执行决策，但也会带来延迟。

sents.en: The design objective is thus to coordinate these activities, rather than maximize reasoning effort or minimize interaction count in isolation.
sents.zh: 因此，设计目标是协调这些活动，而不是孤立地最大化推理投入或最小化交互次数。

paragraphs.en: Environmental acceptance further makes reassessment consequential. A correct answer can be followed by a rejected interaction, and dispatch can leave the intended effect unresolved. Conversely, when recovery is permitted, feedback from a failed attempt can support a useful continuation. These conditions motivate the following design choices.
paragraphs.zh: 环境验收进一步使重新评估变得重要。 正确的答案之后可能跟着被拒绝的交互，而调度也可能使预期效果未得到解决。 反过来，当允许恢复时，来自失败尝试的反馈可以支持有用的后续行动。 这些条件促成了以下设计选择。

sents.en: Environmental acceptance further makes reassessment consequential.
sents.zh: 环境验收进一步使重新评估变得重要。

sents.en: A correct answer can be followed by a rejected interaction, and dispatch can leave the intended effect unresolved.
sents.zh: 正确的答案之后可能跟着被拒绝的交互，而调度也可能使预期效果未得到解决。

sents.en: Conversely, when recovery is permitted, feedback from a failed attempt can support a useful continuation.
sents.zh: 反过来，当允许恢复时，来自失败尝试的反馈可以支持有用的后续行动。

sents.en: These conditions motivate the following design choices.
sents.zh: 这些条件促成了以下设计选择。

paragraphs.en: An evidence-grounded commitment preserves a specific supported continuation across successive proposals. It allows the runtime to act on an available result while the supporting conditions and applicable execution constraints remain satisfied, rather than reopen selection without a decision-relevant reason. Relevant changes in the target, page context, or feedback can instead justify renewed grounding or solving. This reuse rule neither certifies semantic correctness nor implies that further computation has no value merely because a candidate operation exists.
paragraphs.zh: 有证据支撑的承诺会在连续多个提案之间保持一个特定的、有支撑的后续动作。 它允许运行时在支撑条件和适用的执行约束仍然满足的情况下，基于可用的结果采取行动，而不是在没有与决策相关的理由时重新开启选择。 目标、页面上下文或反馈中的相关变化反而可以证明需要重新进行证据锚定或求解。 这一复用规则既不证明语义正确性，也不意味着仅仅因为存在一个候选操作，进一步的计算就没有价值。

sents.en: An evidence-grounded commitment preserves a specific supported continuation across successive proposals.
sents.zh: 有证据支撑的承诺会在连续多个提案之间保持一个特定的、有支撑的后续动作。

sents.en: It allows the runtime to act on an available result while the supporting conditions and applicable execution constraints remain satisfied, rather than reopen selection without a decision-relevant reason.
sents.zh: 它允许运行时在支撑条件和适用的执行约束仍然满足的情况下，基于可用的结果采取行动，而不是在没有与决策相关的理由时重新开启选择。

sents.en: Relevant changes in the target, page context, or feedback can instead justify renewed grounding or solving.
sents.zh: 目标、页面上下文或反馈中的相关变化反而可以证明需要重新进行证据锚定或求解。

sents.en: This reuse rule neither certifies semantic correctness nor implies that further computation has no value merely because a candidate operation exists.
sents.zh: 这一复用规则既不证明语义正确性，也不意味着仅仅因为存在一个候选操作，进一步的计算就没有价值。

paragraphs.en: An incorrect progress judgment can cause subsequent operations to rely on an unfinished prerequisite. Verification incurs a cost, but can prevent downstream rework by informing whether to advance, reassess, or continue observing. This motivates checks tied to capability and task criteria, not a separate verification call after every internal computation. The objective is to obtain evidence relevant to continuation while satisfying the applicable verification requirements, rather than add checks indiscriminately or omit required verification to reduce measured time.
paragraphs.zh: 错误的进度判断可能导致后续操作依赖尚未完成的前置条件。 验证会产生成本，但可以通过判断是继续推进、重新评估还是继续观察，来避免下游的返工。 这促使我们将检查与能力和任务标准绑定，而不是在每次内部计算后单独调用一次验证。 目标是在满足适用的验证要求的同时获得与是否继续相关的证据，而不是不加区分地增加检查，或为缩短所测时间而省略必要的验证。

sents.en: An incorrect progress judgment can cause subsequent operations to rely on an unfinished prerequisite.
sents.zh: 错误的进度判断可能导致后续操作依赖尚未完成的前置条件。

sents.en: Verification incurs a cost, but can prevent downstream rework by informing whether to advance, reassess, or continue observing.
sents.zh: 验证会产生成本，但可以通过判断是继续推进、重新评估还是继续观察，来避免下游的返工。

sents.en: This motivates checks tied to capability and task criteria, not a separate verification call after every internal computation.
sents.zh: 这促使我们将检查与能力和任务标准绑定，而不是在每次内部计算后单独调用一次验证。

sents.en: The objective is to obtain evidence relevant to continuation while satisfying the applicable verification requirements, rather than add checks indiscriminately or omit required verification to reduce measured time.
sents.zh: 目标是在满足适用的验证要求的同时获得与是否继续相关的证据，而不是不加区分地增加检查，或为缩短所测时间而省略必要的验证。

paragraphs.en: Recovery revises assumptions undermined by feedback while retaining evidence that remains applicable. A rejected solution need not invalidate every geometric observation; a changed page may require renewed grounding without changing the user goal. Feedback and execution history should therefore guide subsequent attempts toward unresolved issues rather than mechanical repetition. Budgets limit designated recovery operations, as specified in Appendix B.4 . These limits constrain repeated attempts but do not, by themselves, establish a bound on all model calls or external waiting time.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复会修订被反馈所推翻的假设，同时保留仍然适用的证据。 被否决的解决方案不必使每一条几何观察都失效；换页可能需要重新进行定位，而不改变用户目标。 因此，反馈与执行历史应当引导后续尝试去解决尚未解决的问题，而不是机械地重复。 预算会限制指定的恢复操作，具体规定见附录 B.4。 这些限制约束的是重复尝试，但它们本身并不会对所有模型调用或外部等待时间设定上限。

paragraphs.en: The three principles are design choices inspired by rational metareasoning, not theorems derived from an optimal metalevel policy. The framework implements them through accessible evidence, execution history, and budget constraints, without requiring an online estimator of expected computation value or a complete probabilistic model of computational outcomes. Neither the hierarchical solving tree nor the runtime supervisor is claimed to maximize a computation-value objective. Their effects on success and end-to-end latency are evaluated empirically under the timing and acceptance definitions in Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 这三条原则是受理性元推理启发的设计选择，而非从最优元层策略推导出的定理。 该框架通过可获取的证据、执行历史和预算约束来实现这些原则，而无需在线估计计算期望价值，也无需计算结果的完整概率模型。 无论是分层求解树还是运行时监督器，都不声称能最大化计算价值目标。 它们对成功率和端到端延迟的影响，在附录 A 的计时与接受定义下进行实证评估。

paragraphs.en: This appendix provides experimental configurations, extended quantitative analysis, statistical stability analysis, and a detailed examination of runtime ablations. A paired analysis separates static correctness from dynamic acceptance. Failure mode analysis covers twelve baseline cases and two text-based SolveBind case studies connecting runtime decisions to successful and failed outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录提供了实验配置、扩展的定量分析、统计稳定性分析，以及对运行时消融的详细考察。 配对分析将静态正确性与动态接受度区分开来。 失败模式分析涵盖十二个基线案例和两个基于文本的 SolveBind 案例研究，将运行时决策与成功和失败的结果联系起来。

paragraphs.en: The CAPTCHA evaluation runs in Google Chrome ( com.android.chrome ) on an Android Virtual Device identified as agent-debug (device serial emulator-5554 ). The emulator uses an ARM64-v8a Google Play system image at Android API level 36 and is configured in portrait orientation at 1080 × 2400 1080\times 2400 pixels and 420 dpi, with 4 vCPUs and 2048 MB of RAM. ADB opens each locally hosted CAPTCHA page and performs screenshots, text entry, taps, and drag gestures. Each of the nine HLL task families provides 100 instances; the backbone–harness comparisons in Table 1 score 90 instances in total, while the native UI-TARS-1.5-7B evaluation in Appendix D.3 scores the full 900-instance population. Episodes use distraction level 2 and hard difficulty where the task family supports it, otherwise normal ; the distraction level does not specify a fixed number of distractors. Each episode creates an independent local session from its task instance and seed, resets the evaluation state, and destroys the associated state after termination.
paragraphs.zh: CAPTCHA 评测运行在 Android 虚拟设备 agent-debug（设备序列号 emulator-5554）上的 Google Chrome（com.android.chrome）中进行。 该模拟器使用 Android API 级别 36 的 ARM64-v8a Google Play 系统镜像，配置为竖屏方向、1080 × 2400 1080\times 2400 像素、420 dpi，拥有 4 个 vCPU 和 2048 MB 内存。 ADB 打开每个本地托管的 CAPTCHA 页面，并执行截图、文本输入、点击和拖动手势。 九个 HLL 任务族各提供 100 个实例；表 1 中的骨干—测试框架对比共对 90 个实例进行评分，而附录 D.3 中的原生 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 评测则对全部 900 个实例总体进行评分。 在任务族支持的情况下，回合使用干扰级别 2 和 hard 难度，否则使用 normal；干扰级别并不指定固定数量的干扰项。 每个回合从其任务实例和种子创建独立的本地会话，重置评测状态，并在终止后销毁相关状态。

paragraphs.en: AndroidWorld evaluates application-level task completion on a Pixel 6 emulator running Android 13/API 33 with an ARM64 image at 1080 × 2400 1080\times 2400 pixels. The runtime ablation is a separate batch, containing 25 instances of each CAPTCHA type and 225 episodes per configuration.
